args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the exporter binary (e.g., '--postfix-queue-dir /var/spool/postfix --web.listen-address=:9154'). All flags supported by prometheus-postfix-exporter may be used. Leave empty to use defaults.

web_listen_address.description: Address and port on which the exporter listens for HTTP requests. Use 'host:port' format (e.g., ':9154' or '127.0.0.1:9154').

web_metrics_path.description: HTTP path under which metrics are exposed.

postfix_queue_dir.description: Path to the Postfix spool directory containing active, defer, defer, etc. subdirectories.

enable_tls.description: Enable TLS (HTTPS) for the metrics endpoint. Requires valid certificate and key paths.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format). Required if TLS is enabled.

tls_key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format). Required if TLS is enabled.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for Postfix CLI commands (e.g., postqueue -p) before timing out.

enabled.description: Whether to collect this category of stats.

stats.description: List of statistics categories to enable or disable. Each entry specifies a stats group and whether it should be collected.
